standard_prerequisites.name: Normalized subobject
standard_prerequisites.use: The subobject V' with trivial normalization in high degrees is the one of Lemma lemma-simplicial-abelian-n-skel-sub.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 3374-3379): for U an m-truncated object of an abelian category A and n > m, one has N(i_{m!}U)_n = 0.

Verification (proof lines 3381-3389): let V = i_{m!}U and let V' be the subobject equal to V in degrees at most m with trivial normalization above, of Lemma lemma-simplicial-abelian-n-skel-sub; since sk_m V' = U, the adjunction formula provides the retraction of the inclusion, so V' = V and the normalization of V vanishes above degree m.
proof_roadmap: Apply the adjunction i_{m!} -| sk_m to sk_m V' = U.
Conclude V' = V and read off the vanishing.
